title.en: Give the inspection station a comparison

t.zh: 你接手一台图像质检台。它能拍摄工件，却还不会比较、去干扰或找出轮廓。你将从读数开始造比较仪，再装出扫描器与频率分析仪；每次通过的电路，都会成为后续机器能复用的部件。
t.en: You inherit an image inspection station. It captures items but cannot yet compare them, suppress nuisance or measure contours. Build a comparator, then a scanner and frequency analyser. Each passed circuit becomes a reusable part.

t.zh: 先造比较部件：把同一位置、同一通道的观测与参照对应起来。这里光照固定、图像已对齐；点击图格查看位置与原始读数。数值计算由电路完成，不要求手算。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>
t.en: First compare observations and references at matching positions and channels. Lighting is fixed and images are aligned. Select cells to inspect positions and original readings. The circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref> <wiki-ref to="pixel-coordinate-convention"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 差异图保留变化位置；绝对值兼顾变亮和变暗。它仍不能自行区分缺陷、错位与光照变化。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Differences localise change; absolute value retains brightening and darkening. They do not by themselves identify defects, motion or lighting. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 先保留变化方向：参照变为观测时，逐格输出观测减参照。
brief.en: First retain direction: output observation minus reference at matching cells.

naiveWhy.zh: 正号表示比参照更亮，负号表示更暗。交换两张图会交换方向。
naiveWhy.en: Positive is brighter than the reference; negative is darker. Swapping images reverses direction.

hint.zh: 先观察一个变亮和一个变暗的位置。数值计算自动完成。
hint.en: Inspect one brighter and one darker location. Arithmetic is automatic.

brief.zh: 质检同时关注变亮和变暗。输出每格变化的大小；相同位置输出 0。
brief.en: Inspection must retain both brightening and darkening. Output change size at each cell; unchanged cells give 0.

naiveWhy.zh: 带符号的差会把变暗显示为负值，不能直接当作变化大小。
naiveWhy.en: Signed differences retain negative darkening; they are not change magnitudes.

hint.zh: 沿用刚才的差异电路，考虑怎样保留大小而忽略方向。
hint.en: Reuse your signed comparison and consider retaining size without direction.

t.zh: 带正负号的差已经保留了变化方向。现在质检同时关心变亮和变暗；新的绝对值元件保留数值大小，让两类变化都进入比较结果。
t.en: Signed differences retain direction. Inspection now needs both brightening and darkening. The new absolute-value component retains size for both kinds of change.

desc.zh: 比较两张同尺寸图，输出逐位置、逐通道的绝对差。
desc.en: Compare equal-size images using per-location, per-channel absolute difference.

t.zh: 传送带移动了工件，直接比较会把移动也标成变化。夹具已经测出取样偏移，不需要你估计位移。给比较器补上位置对应，再用真正的缺口检验它。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The conveyor moved the item, so direct comparison reports motion as change. A fixture already measured the sampling offset; you do not estimate it. Add correspondence before comparison and test a real defect. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 已知位移能修复这部分位置对应，但没有解决未知配准。移动位置与改变亮度是不同操作。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A known offset repairs correspondence, not unknown registration. Moving sample positions differs from changing intensity. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移向量 d = (dx, dy)。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
brief.en: The fixture supplies a sampling offset vector d = (dx, dy). Read the observation at that offset before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.

naiveWhy.zh: 错位让原本相同的结构落在不同位置。调整亮度不能修复位置对应。
naiveWhy.en: Misalignment compares different structures; changing intensity cannot repair correspondence.

hint.zh: d 的分量为正，表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
hint.en: A positive component of d means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

t.zh: 相机只观测了图内的格子，位移取样会碰到缺少的邻居。本任务假设图外读数为 0：这是最简单的约定，不猜测图外有什么。先查看独立示例，区分已有读数与补入的值。
t.en: The camera observed only the cells inside the image, so an offset read meets missing neighbours. This task assumes 0 outside: the simplest convention, guessing nothing about what lies beyond. Inspect the independent example first to tell observed readings from filled-in values.

desc.zh: 按给定偏移向量 d 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
desc.en: Read an observation at an offset vector d and compare with the reference, using zero outside.

t.zh: 比较器已经能处理夹具给出的错位，现在把它接入质检规范。图像中的变化证据与最终的通过条件不是一回事：相机小幅读数波动在规范允许范围内。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The comparator handles the fixture offset. Connect it to the inspection specification: measured change and a decision condition are different. Small reading fluctuations are allowed. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 对齐、测量与判定各司其职。质检结论仍依赖给定光照、位移与容差。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Alignment, measurement and decision have separate roles. The inspection conclusion depends on supplied lighting, offsets and tolerance. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 容差由质检规范给定。输出对齐差异，以及严格超过容差的变化标记（1）；其余为 0。
brief.en: Tolerance is supplied by the inspection specification. Output aligned differences and a 1 only where a difference strictly exceeds tolerance.

naiveWhy.zh: 标记应当随变化超过容差而出现，不是把合格位置标为缺陷。
naiveWhy.en: Mark changes exceeding tolerance, not positions that remain within it.

hint.zh: 先检查差异输出，再检查比较的两个输入谁在前。小于元件在 a<b 时输出 1。
hint.en: Check the difference first, then the order of the comparison inputs. Less returns 1 when a<b.

t.zh: 质检台只能逐位置比较，无法利用周围读数区分细碎干扰和较大结构。这章要造邻域处理器，再把它装成扫描器。先从三个位置开始：取样位置与贡献权重分开，所有数值由电路计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The station compares individual locations but cannot use surrounding readings to separate fine nuisance from broader structure. Build a neighbourhood processor and then a scanner. Start with three positions: sample locations and contributions are separate; the circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 同一套位置权重可以沿行或列使用；读取方向决定哪些邻居参与，权重的位置与符号决定各自的贡献。每次处理仍然只覆盖一条线。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: One positional weighting rule can act along rows or columns. Direction selects the neighbours; weight position and sign determine their contributions. Each pass still covers one line. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用给定的位置权重组合左、中、右三个读数。取样方向 d=(1,0)，前侧读 -d，后侧读 d。输出与输入同尺寸，图外取 0；权重不必总为正，也不自动归一化。
brief.en: Combine left, centre and right readings with the supplied positional weights. The direction is d=(1,0): read the first at -d and the last at d. Preserve image size, read zero outside, and do not automatically normalise or discard negative weights.

after.zh: 权重的位置、符号与总和分别影响方向、响应与增益。负权重和非单位增益也有用途。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Weight positions, signs and sum affect direction, response and gain. Negative weights and non-unit gain can be useful. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 位置权重跟随读取的位置；交换两侧会反转非对称规则。恒定图还会显示权重和造成的增益。
naiveWhy.en: Weights belong to positions. Swapping sides reverses an asymmetric rule; constants also expose the gain from the weight sum.

hint.zh: 亮点能显示谁贡献到哪个位置；先把三路分别接到输出观察，再组合。
hint.en: An impulse reveals which sample contributes where. Inspect the branches before combining them.

hint.zh: 常量图检验总增益，非对称权重检验方向；系统计算所有乘积与和。
hint.en: Constants test gain and asymmetric weights test direction; products and sums are automatic.

t.zh: 常数元件在这里解锁二维向量：选择“二维向量”，填写 x、y，就能从一个口输出固定方向。预设电路已放入横向方向 (1,0)；标量常数仍用于数值运算。题目给定且随测试变化的读数和权重仍从输入元件读取。
t.en: The constant now supports 2D vectors: choose 2D vector and enter x/y to output one fixed direction. The starter supplies horizontal direction (1,0); scalar constants still serve arithmetic. Read test-dependent readings and weights from their supplied inputs.

brief.zh: 用三点加权器，将给定 [前, 中, 后] 权重向量用于每列。预设电路里的方向常数 d=(0,1) 对应上、中、下；保持尺寸，图外取 0。
brief.en: Apply the supplied [first, centre, last] weight vector down each column with the weighted-line preset. The starter direction constant d=(0,1) reads above/centre/below. Preserve size and use zero outside.

naiveWhy.zh: 交换前后读取方向会反转非对称权重的响应。用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。
naiveWhy.en: Reversing the read direction reverses the response of asymmetric weights. Use unequal side weights to distinguish above and below.

hint.zh: 先用单个亮点观察响应是在同一行还是同一列展开；再用不对称权重检查上、下是否交换。无需手算数值。
hint.en: Use one impulse to see whether support spreads along its row or column, then asymmetric weights to check above/below order. Numerical calculation is automatic.

t.zh: 横向三格的加权关系已经验证。现在用三点加权器复用固定计算：权重整组接入，用电路里的方向常数 (0,1) 处理一列。预设元件不使用之前的电路。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The horizontal three-sample relationship is established. Reuse the fixed computation with the weighted-line preset: connect the whole weight vector and use direction constant (0,1) for columns. The preset does not use the earlier circuit. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

t.zh: 彩色测量、邻域处理和方向响应都已经由你造出。现在给扫描台装上整条路径：先控制读数与尺度，再测变化，最后按已知规范输出标记。这里不要求检测完整纸张或做透视矫正。 <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>
t.en: You have built channel measurement, neighbourhood processing and directional responses. Assemble the scanner path: control readings and scale, measure change, then mark according to the specification. Full document detection and perspective correction are outside this task. <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 已验证的部件组成大机器，顺序和边界仍然重要。扫描响应是视觉证据，不是完整物体轮廓。 <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Verified parts form larger machines, but order and borders still matter. Scanner responses are evidence, not complete object contours. <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 按仪器规范汇合彩色读数（1/4、1/2、1/4），在测方向前用给定高斯权重平滑，输出 Sobel 强度及严格超过阈值的标记。
brief.en: Use channel weights 1/4,1/2,1/4; smooth with supplied Gaussian weights before directional measurement. Output Sobel strength and marks strictly above threshold.

naiveWhy.zh: 阈值不能代替输入尺度的控制。没有前置平滑时，细碎变化也会进入方向响应。
naiveWhy.en: Thresholding does not replace scale control: fine variation reaches the directional response without preprocessing.

hint.zh: 分别检查单通道读数、平滑图和方向响应，找出干扰第一次被压低的位置。
hint.en: Inspect channel measurement, smoothing and directional responses to locate where nuisance is suppressed.

title.en: Reuse the line along two axes

t.zh: 横向与纵向的位置规则已经分别验证，但一次处理仍只覆盖一条线。现在让两次处理共同覆盖二维邻域。你决定两次处理怎样连接，对比亮点的十字和矩形响应。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref> 三点加权器是固定计算的预设元件：接入一根权重向量线，顺序为 [前, 中, 后]。你决定两次处理怎样连接。
t.en: The horizontal and vertical positional rules have been tested separately, but each pass still covers one line. Make two passes cover a 2D neighbourhood. Decide how they connect by comparing cross and rectangular impulse responses. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref> The weighted-line preset accepts one weight-vector wire in [first, centre, last] order. Decide how to connect the two passes.

after.zh: 连续两轴处理形成外积贡献，不等于两图相加。只有可分离核才能这样替代，边界也须一致。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Consecutive axis passes form outer-product contributions, not a sum of two images. Equivalence requires a separable kernel and matched borders. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 使用三点加权器，把给定的 [前, 中, 后] 权重向量先后用于两轴。输出应符合二维外积权重，而不是两张单轴结果相加。横向 (1,0) 和纵向 (0,1) 已由预设电路中的两个常数元件提供。
brief.en: Use the weighted-line preset to apply the supplied [first, centre, last] weight vector along both axes consecutively. Match the 2D outer-product rule rather than adding two single-axis outputs. The starter supplies horizontal (1,0) and vertical (0,1) direction constants.

naiveWhy.zh: 独立处理两轴后相加只覆盖十字形贡献；前后组合才会让角上的邻居参与。
naiveWhy.en: Adding independent passes gives cross-shaped support; serial passes include corner contributions.

hint.zh: 用单个亮点观察角上的贡献从哪里来。两个方向常数只决定取样方向，不改变权重。
hint.en: Use an impulse to inspect corner contributions. The two direction constants select sample directions without changing the weights.

desc.zh: 将同一权重向量先后用于两轴，运行你搭建的双轴处理电路。
desc.en: Apply one weight vector consecutively along both axes using your two-axis circuit.

title.en: Build a processor with replaceable kernels

t.zh: 三点加权能处理一条线，但斜向和其他形状需要更一般的邻域。工具把重复取样展开为表，你把刚才学会的加权关系扩展到整张权重表。工具不会替你加权求和。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A line cannot express every diagonal or local pattern. A helper unfolds repeated sampling into tables. Extend the weighted relation to the entire table; the helper does not calculate a weighted sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 一台加权处理器能复用不同核。核不翻转、书写位置直接对应邻域时，得到互相关。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
after.en: One weighted processor reuses different kernels. Written-order weights matched directly to neighbours compute correlation. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 每个原位置展开为一行，输出各邻居的带权贡献，暂不合并。行内位置按权重表逐行对应，图外读数取 0。
brief.en: For each original location, output one row of weighted neighbour contributions without combining them. Within a row, match written kernel order; read zero outside.

naiveWhy.zh: 展开只收集读数，不施加权重。中心为 0 的核仍可能让周围位置产生贡献。
naiveWhy.en: Unfolding collects samples without applying weights. A zero centre weight does not remove contributions from neighbours.

t.zh: 三点加权已经把位置与权重分开。现在邻域可以有多行：展开工具为每个输出位置保留一行读数，并给出一一对应的权重；先检查每一路的贡献，再汇合结果。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The line separated sample positions from weights. A neighbourhood can now have several rows: unfolding gives one sample row per output location and matching weights. Inspect contributions before combining them. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 展开只收集读数，不施加权重。中心为 0 的核仍可能让周围位置产生贡献。
hint.en: Unfolding collects samples without applying weights. A zero centre weight does not remove contributions from neighbours.

brief.zh: 造一个接受任意奇数尺寸权重表的局部处理器。展开邻域只给读数和权重；你负责组合它们，并为每个原位置得到一个结果。
brief.en: Build a local processor accepting any odd-sized weight table. Unfold windows supplies samples and weights only; combine them and produce one result per original location.

t.zh: 每一行现在是一处输出的全部贡献。逐行汇总先把它们相加，得到一列；还原形状再按原图的行序排回宽高。两个工具只处理重复计算与排布，你决定哪些量应被汇合。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Each row now contains all contributions to one output. Sum rows into one column, then restore original dimensions in row order. The services handle repeated arithmetic and arrangement; decide which quantities belong in the sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 邻域读数必须先按给定权重形成贡献；直接汇总会把核中应被忽略的位置也算进去。
naiveWhy.en: Samples must first receive their supplied weights; summing raw readings counts neighbours the kernel excludes.

hint.zh: 每行是一处输出的邻域。先检查读数与权重的对应，再决定如何把一行变成一个结果。
hint.en: Each row is one output neighbourhood. Inspect sample/weight correspondence, then decide how to reduce the row.

desc.zh: 将权重表直接对齐邻域并求加权和。运行你自己的电路，图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Compute written-order weighted neighbourhood sums using your circuit, with explicit borders.

title.zh: 同一个核，方向为何不同

t.zh: 处理器能处理任意核，但课程公式和一些工具使用不同的核约定。对称平滑核掩盖了差别，现在用非对称核把问题显露出来，再给自己的处理器加上明确的数学接口。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The processor accepts any kernel, but conventions differ. Symmetric smoothing hides that difference. Expose it with an asymmetric kernel and build an explicit mathematical interface. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 对称核掩盖了方向差别；非对称核能区分数学卷积与互相关。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Symmetric kernels hide the orientation distinction; asymmetric kernels expose convolution versus correlation. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 接口接收数学卷积核。让非对称核的方向与卷积定义一致，保持输出尺寸和零边界。
brief.en: The interface receives mathematical convolution kernels. Match their orientation, including asymmetric kernels, with same-size output and zero boundaries.

naiveWhy.zh: 对称核不能区分两种约定；非对称亮点响应会暴露核的方向是否反转。
naiveWhy.en: Symmetric kernels hide the distinction; asymmetric impulse responses expose orientation.

hint.zh: 用非对称权重表与单个亮点检查方向。翻转核只调整权重表，不是翻转待处理图。
hint.en: Inspect an asymmetric kernel on an impulse. Reverse the weight table, not the image.

desc.zh: 翻转书写核后运行自己的互相关器，图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Reverse the written kernel and run your correlator with explicit borders.

title.zh: 同一部件，压低还是增强细节

t.zh: 双轴处理器已经能汇合邻居。现在用课程给出的高斯权重处理细碎变化，再把被抑制的细节用于另一种任务。权重和与小数由系统计算，你决定图像之间的关系。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The two-axis processor combines neighbours. Use supplied Gaussian weights to suppress fine variation, then reuse the removed detail for another purpose. Weight arithmetic is supplied; decide the image relationships. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 平滑也会损失细节。增强需要带符号细节，不能用绝对差替代；强增强还可能放大干扰。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Smoothing also removes detail. Enhancement needs signed detail rather than absolute difference, and can amplify nuisance. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 使用给定的归一化权重做双轴平滑，图外延续最近边缘。恒定图的边缘必须仍是同一个读数；变化图仍应发生平滑。
brief.en: Smooth along both axes with the supplied normalised weights, extending nearest edge values outside. Constant-image edges must stay constant; varying images must still be smoothed.

naiveWhy.zh: 补 0 会在恒定图边缘引入不存在的暗读数。延续边缘只改变图外取值，不能跳过图内平滑。
naiveWhy.en: Zero extension invents dark samples at constant-image edges. Edge replication changes outside reads without skipping interior smoothing.

t.zh: 双轴加权已经可用，但补 0 会让恒定图的边缘变暗。先单独更换边界假设：普通照片在边缘之外多半还是相近的景物，所以让图外维持最近边缘的读数。用恒定图和变化图区分边界效果与平滑效果。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The two-axis filter works, but zero extension darkens constant-image edges. First change only the boundary assumption: in an ordinary photograph the scene just beyond the edge usually resembles the edge, so outside reads retain the nearest edge value. Contrast constant and varying images to separate boundary effects from smoothing. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 先比较角落与内部，再检查亮点是否仍会扩散；恒定图不变并不等于直接输出原图。
hint.en: Compare corners with the interior, then check whether an impulse still spreads. Preserving a constant image is not the same as passing every image through unchanged.

brief.zh: 用给定的归一化权重做双轴平滑，图外延续最近边缘；另输出原图相对平滑图的带符号细节，使平滑图加上细节恰好回到原图。
brief.en: Smooth along both axes with the supplied normalised weights, extending nearest edge values outside; also output the signed detail of the original relative to the smoothed image, so that smooth plus detail restores the original exactly.

naiveWhy.zh: 绝对差只记下改动有多大，丢掉了方向：暗点中心的细节变成正数，平滑图加上它也回不到原图。
naiveWhy.en: Absolute difference keeps only how much changed and drops the direction: the dark dot’s centre turns positive, and smooth plus it no longer restores the original.

t.zh: 边缘读数已经稳定。平滑图比原图少了一部分变化：先把这部分单独取出，保留成一张图。比较亮线和暗点，确认它记下的不只是改动有多大。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Boundary readings are now stable. The smoothed image lacks part of the original’s variation: separate that part and keep it as an image. Compare a bright line with a dark dot to confirm it records more than how much changed. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 看暗点图的中心：原图在那里比平滑图暗还是亮？细节在那里应当是什么符号？
hint.en: Look at the centre of the dark dot: is the original darker or brighter there than the smoothed image? What sign should the detail have there?

brief.zh: 用已归一化的高斯样本权重平滑，再按给定强度增强原图相对平滑图的带符号细节。另输出平滑改动的大小。
brief.en: Smooth with supplied normalised Gaussian sample weights, enhance signed detail at the given strength, and report the magnitude of the smoothing change.

naiveWhy.zh: 加到平滑图上只是把抹掉的部分补回来：强度为 1 时得到的正是原图，没有任何增强。
naiveWhy.en: Adding to the smoothed image only restores what was removed: at strength 1 it gives back the original, with no enhancement.

hint.zh: 比较纹理、边缘和常量图。改动大小与要加回的带符号细节承担不同职责。
hint.en: Compare texture, edges and constants. Change magnitude and the signed detail to add back serve different purposes.

t.zh: 带符号的细节已经取出。现在按给定强度用它增强图像，并另外输出平滑改动的大小，区分“被移除的变化”和“改动有多大”。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The signed detail is now separated. Use it to enhance the image at the supplied strength, and also report the magnitude of the smoothing change, distinguishing the removed variation from how much changed. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

t.zh: 卷积器在内部工作正常，常量图的边缘却可能变暗。图外没有观测，每种延续都是一种猜测，适合不同的材料。现在逐项明确图外模型，再比较同尺寸延续与只保留有效内部这两种接口。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The convolver works inside the image, yet a constant image may darken at its edges. Nothing is observed outside, so every extension is a guess that suits different material. Now fix the outside model task by task, then compare same-size extension with keeping only the valid interior. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 补边是假设，不是观测。有效域避免图外读数，却改变输出尺寸；算法对照要匹配边界和域。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Padding is an assumption, not observation. Valid output avoids outside reads but changes size. Fair comparisons match boundaries and domains. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 本任务假设图外延续最近边缘读数。保持卷积规则，修复边界输出。
brief.en: This task assumes replicated edge readings. Keep the convolution rule and adapt its boundary output.

naiveWhy.zh: 边界缺少真实读数，补 0 并不等于其他延续假设。常量图和非恒定边缘会区分它们。
naiveWhy.en: Missing neighbours are not observations. Zero extension differs from the specified assumption; constants and varied edges reveal it.

hint.zh: 打开自己卷积器的图外假设。观察变化集中在哪些输出位置。
hint.en: Inspect your convolver’s outside setting and where its effects occur.

t.zh: 这里把同一卷积器放到边界问题中检验。先用最常见的假设：普通照片的边缘之外通常是相近的景物，图外就延续最近边缘的读数。对照恒定图与变化边缘，检查这种假设影响哪些输出。
t.en: This puts the same convolver to a boundary problem. Start with the most common assumption: beyond the edge of an ordinary photograph the scene is usually similar, so outside reads continue the nearest edge value. Contrast constant images with varied edges to see which outputs the assumption affects.

brief.zh: 本任务假设图外周期相接。保持卷积规则，修复边界输出。
brief.en: This task assumes periodic continuation. Keep the convolution rule and adapt its boundary output.

naiveWhy.zh: 边界缺少真实读数，补 0 并不等于其他延续假设。常量图和非恒定边缘会区分它们。
naiveWhy.en: Missing neighbours are not observations. Zero extension differs from the specified assumption; constants and varied edges reveal it.

hint.zh: 把边缘两端想成相接的环：起点之前会读到哪一端？在非恒定图上对照复制边缘。
hint.en: Imagine the two ends connected in a loop: which end supplies reads before the start? Compare with replication on a varied image.

t.zh: 现在处理周期材料，例如可以无缝平铺的纹理：右边缘之外本来就接着左边缘，所以图像一端离开后，从另一端继续读取。普通照片的两端互不相关，这样补会把另一侧的内容带进边缘。检查示例中负列号和超过宽度的位置。
t.en: Now the material is periodic, such as a seamlessly tileable texture: beyond its right edge the left edge truly continues, so reads leaving one end resume at the other. The two ends of an ordinary photograph are unrelated, and this would carry the far side's content into the edge. Inspect the negative and out-of-range columns in the example.

brief.zh: 本任务假设图外镜像延续（含边缘格）。保持卷积规则，修复边界输出。
brief.en: This task assumes reflection including the edge sample. Keep the convolution rule and adapt its boundary output.

naiveWhy.zh: 边界缺少真实读数，补 0 并不等于其他延续假设。常量图和非恒定边缘会区分它们。
naiveWhy.en: Missing neighbours are not observations. Zero extension differs from the specified assumption; constants and varied edges reveal it.

hint.zh: 本任务的镜像包含边缘格：在一行 [a,b,c] 外读一次得到 c，再往外得到 b。与周期延续比较。
hint.en: Reflection here repeats the edge sample: after [a,b,c] the next reads are c, then b. Compare against periodic continuation.

t.zh: 这次图像以边缘为界镜像延续，并包含边缘格：两侧对称，边缘处不出现突变，常用来减少补边造出的人工边界。示例在列号 2、3、4 读到 0.9、0.9、0.5：边缘格重复一次，再反向延续。观察这与周期相接有什么不同。
t.en: This time the image is mirrored at its edge, including the edge sample: both sides match, so no jump appears at the edge, and this often reduces the artificial borders padding creates. The example reads 0.9, 0.9, 0.5 at columns 2, 3, 4: the edge sample repeats once, then continues backwards. Note how this differs from periodic continuation.

brief.zh: 另一个接口只接受邻域完全在原图内的结果。每轴半径 r = (rx, ry) 已给出，保留有效内部；不用猜测图外读数。
brief.en: Another interface accepts only results whose neighbourhood is fully inside. The supplied per-axis radii r = (rx, ry) identify the valid interior; no outside readings are assumed.

naiveWhy.zh: 有效输出的尺寸会缩小。换一种补边规则并不能产生这个更小的输出域。
naiveWhy.en: Valid output is smaller. Changing padding alone does not produce that output domain.

hint.zh: 系统按 r 的两个分量自动计算宽高，只保留不触及图外的位置。
hint.en: The helper computes the dimensions from the two components of r and retains only interior locations.

t.zh: 还可以不猜图外读数：只保留邻域完整落在原图内的输出。代价是宽高缩小。示例自动标出保留位置，本任务的 rx、ry 已给定。
t.en: Another choice avoids assuming outside readings: retain only full neighbourhoods. The output becomes smaller. The example marks valid centres; task rx and ry are supplied.

t.zh: 卷积器已经有明确的核与边界约定。扫描器还需要知道变化沿哪条轴发生，以及亮度在增大还是减小。用两种单轴斜坡区分这两件事。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The convolver now has explicit kernel and boundary conventions. The scanner needs the axis and sign of change. Distinguish them using single-axis ramps. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 梯度分量保留变化方向与正负。负响应仍有效，不能因灰度显示变黑就丢掉。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Gradient components retain direction and sign. Negative responses remain valid even when their grayscale display is black. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 给定横向数学差分核，造出横向和纵向的带符号响应。x 向右、y 向下为正，图外延续边缘。
brief.en: Use the supplied horizontal mathematical derivative kernel to produce signed x and y responses. Positive axes are right and down; extend edge readings.

naiveWhy.zh: 另一条轴的响应需要另一方向的邻域，不能复制同一张响应图。
naiveWhy.en: The other component needs a differently oriented neighbourhood, not a duplicate response.

hint.zh: 先看只有一条轴发生变化的斜坡。核的方向与输出分量的方向应一致。
hint.en: Start with ramps changing along only one axis. Match kernel and component directions.

desc.zh: 用给定横向数学差分核及其转置，给出 gx、gy；图外规则可设置。
desc.en: Apply a supplied derivative kernel and its transpose to obtain gx and gy, with explicit borders.

title.zh: 给方向响应装上抗干扰结构

t.zh: 单纯差分也会响应细碎干扰。三点加权器可以沿另一条轴汇合读数；将它接到双轴差分器，再把两种方向统一到强度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Raw differences also respond to fine nuisance. Use the weighted-line part along the other axis, then combine both directional responses into a strength measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 垂直平滑与差分组成 Sobel。强度保留两分量贡献，直接相加可能抵消，也不能据此识别物体。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Sobel combines differentiation and perpendicular smoothing. Length retains both components; direct addition can cancel them. Responses are not recognition. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 保留差分器给出的两个带符号分量，并输出它们作为垂直方向分量时的长度。长度只表示变化有多强，不能被正负抵消。 三点加权器的方向输入用 (dx,dy)=(1,0) 表示横向，(0,1) 表示纵向。
brief.en: Retain both signed derivative components and output their length as perpendicular components. Strength measures change size without cancellation. For the weighted line direction inputs use (dx,dy)=(1,0) horizontally and (0,1) vertically.

naiveWhy.zh: 同时看两个方向都有变化的位置，以及符号相反的位置。保留分量是为了区分方向，长度负责合并强度。
naiveWhy.en: Inspect locations changing in both directions and with opposite signs. Components retain direction; length combines strength.

t.zh: 差分器分别测出横向和纵向变化。两分量有正负号，直接相加会互相抵消；向量长度元件自动计算平方和与平方根。先建立强度测量，再处理干扰。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The derivative measures horizontal and vertical change separately. Signed components can cancel in a sum; the length component supplies the squared sum and square root. Establish strength before suppressing nuisance. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 同时看两个方向都有变化的位置，以及符号相反的位置。保留分量是为了区分方向，长度负责合并强度。
hint.en: Inspect locations changing in both directions and with opposite signs. Components retain direction; length combines strength.

brief.zh: 将差分响应沿垂直于求导的方向用 [1,2,1] 平滑，得到 Sobel gx、gy，再输出两分量的长度。保留带符号分量。 预设电路中的常数元件提供两个方向和 [前,中,后]=[1,2,1] 平滑权重。
brief.en: Smooth each derivative in its perpendicular direction with [1,2,1] to obtain Sobel gx and gy, then output their length. Retain signed components. Starter constants supply the two directions and smoothing weights [first,centre,last]=[1,2,1].

t.zh: 强度测量已经能合并两方向，但差分仍会响应细碎干扰。现在引入垂直于求导方向的平滑，让方向分量先更稳定，再送入已验证的长度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref> 常数元件在这里解锁“三项权重”，按前、中、后填写 [1,2,1]；方向和这组固定权重已放在预设电路中。
t.en: The strength measurement combines both directions, but raw derivatives still respond to fine nuisance. Stabilise each derivative by smoothing perpendicular to its direction before the verified length measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref> The constant now supports three weights in first/centre/last order. The starter includes [1,2,1] and the direction constants.

naiveWhy.zh: Sobel 在求导的垂直方向平滑。沿求导方向再次平滑会改变你要测量的响应。
naiveWhy.en: Sobel smooths perpendicular to differentiation. Smoothing along the derivative axis changes the intended measurement.

hint.zh: 把求导轴和去干扰轴分开考虑。长度元件已经提供平方、相加和开方，不要求你手算。
hint.en: Separate the derivative axis from the smoothing axis. Vector length supplies squaring, addition and square root.

desc.zh: 运行你的差分、垂直平滑与长度电路，输出 gx、gy 和强度；核和图外规则显式给出。
desc.en: Run your derivative, perpendicular-smoothing and length circuit; expose gx, gy and strength with explicit kernel/borders.

t.zh: 扫描器将接收彩色图，不能直接把三个颜色读数当作一个标量强度。把已经学会的加权关系用到通道轴，构建可调整的单通道测量。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The scanner will receive colour images. Three colour readings are not one scalar measurement. Reuse weighted combination along the channel axis to build an adjustable single-channel measurement. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 空间与通道是不同聚合维度。这里的颜色权重是仪器规范，不是任意编码下的物理亮度。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Space and channels are different aggregation dimensions. These colour weights specify an instrument, not universal physical luminance. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 输入为 RGB 读数。按给定通道贡献输出单通道测量；保留空间位置，权重已给定且无需手算。
brief.en: The input contains RGB readings. Combine the supplied channel contributions into one-channel measurements, preserving positions; weights and arithmetic are supplied.

naiveWhy.zh: 空间位置不变不代表三个通道相同。只取 R 会漏掉其他通道的证据。
naiveWhy.en: Matching positions do not make channels identical. Reading only R loses the other channels.

hint.zh: 纯红、纯绿、纯蓝测试会分别显示每个通道是否接入。
hint.en: Pure red, green and blue samples expose each channel’s contribution.

desc.zh: 按输入 wr、wg、wb 汇合 RGB，运行你自己的跨通道加权电路。
desc.en: Combine RGB with wr,wg,wb using your passed channel-weighting circuit.

title.zh: 给扫描台装上频率刻度

t.zh: 扫描器已经能处理局部变化，但规则条纹可能遍布整幅图，靠局部平滑还会损失有用细节。这章要造频率分析仪，先构造能与条纹比较的波形。负值表示围绕零的变化，计算会完整保留。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The scanner handles local changes, but periodic stripes span the image and local smoothing may remove useful detail. Build a frequency analyser, beginning with waves to compare against stripes. Negative readings represent variation around zero and remain intact in computations. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 频率控制重复次数，相位控制排列关系。数值表保留灰度显示无法呈现的读数。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Frequency controls repetitions; phase controls alignment. Numeric tables retain readings hidden by grayscale clipping. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 整行长度表示 1 周，先只产生一个周期。按照给定相位改变起点，不改变周期数；保留波形的正负读数。余弦元件自动计算角度对应的读数。
brief.en: The row length represents one turn. Produce one cycle while changing its starting phase, without changing cycle count. Retain signed values; cosine computes the readings automatically.

naiveWhy.zh: 相位改变同一周期的起点。完全忽略相位会让不同起点得到同一张表；增加整整一周则应回到原来的读数。
naiveWhy.en: Phase changes where a cycle starts. Ignoring it makes different starting phases identical; adding one complete turn should restore the original readings.

t.zh: 频率分析先需要一把可重复的刻度。余弦元件以“周”为角度单位，1 周回到同一读数，四分之一周与半周落在不同位置；数值由元件计算。先只改变起点，观察波形在周期内怎样排列。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Frequency analysis needs a repeatable basis. Cosine takes turns: one turn returns to the same reading, while quarter and half turns occupy different positions. The component computes values. First change the starting phase and inspect arrangement within one cycle. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 相位是所有位置共同的角度偏移；比较四分之一周和整整一周，不需要手算三角函数。
hint.en: Phase is a shared angular offset. Compare a quarter turn with a full turn; no trigonometric calculation is required.

brief.zh: 位置以整行长度为 1，频率是整行的周期数，相位以周计。造一个能够随频率和相位变化的单位幅度余弦波。
brief.en: Positions span one row length; frequency is cycles per row and phase is in turns. Build a unit-amplitude cosine wave that responds to frequency and phase.

t.zh: 单周期的相位变化已经验证。现在把整行的周期数也作为输入：它改变位置刻度走过的圈数，相位仍负责共同的角度偏移。用 0、1 和多个周期区分间距与起点。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Single-cycle phase shifts are verified. Now accept cycles per row as an input: it changes how many turns the position scale traverses, while phase remains a shared offset. Compare zero, one and multiple cycles to distinguish spacing from starting phase. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 频率改变单位长度内转过的周期数，不是把所有位置一起平移。相位才负责共同的角度偏移。
naiveWhy.en: Frequency changes cycles across the row; it is not a common position shift. Phase supplies the common angular offset.

hint.zh: 先固定相位比较不同周期数，再固定周期数比较不同相位。余弦元件自动完成三角函数计算。
hint.en: Hold phase fixed to compare cycle counts, then hold frequency fixed to compare phases. Cosine supplies the arithmetic.

desc.zh: 按位置、频率和相位输出单位幅度余弦波，角度以周计。
desc.en: Generate unit-amplitude cosine readings from positions, frequency and phase in turns.

t.zh: 频率处理器已经能改变尺度，现在把它用于突变信号。硬截止与渐变处理都可能让图像变平滑，却产生不同的空间响应；用自己的比较器观察差别。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Apply the filter to abrupt signals. Hard and tapered gains can both smooth an image yet produce different spatial responses. Inspect them with your comparator. <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 硬截止可能在突变附近振铃。渐变也有细节代价；检查原值，避免显示截断掩盖过冲。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Hard cutoffs can ring near discontinuities. Tapering also costs detail. Inspect raw values so display clipping does not hide overshoot. <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 把同一信号分别送入硬截止与渐变增益，输出两种重建及它们的差异大小。保留小于 0 或大于 1 的原始计算值。
brief.en: Process one signal with hard and tapered gains; output both reconstructions and their difference magnitude. Preserve values below 0 or above 1.

naiveWhy.zh: 平滑形状取决于增益形状，重复硬截止不会得到渐变处理。检查突变附近的振荡与细节损失。
naiveWhy.en: Filter shape follows gain shape; repeating a hard cutoff does not produce tapered filtering. Inspect oscillation and detail loss near discontinuities.

hint.zh: 点开突变附近的格子查看原值。显示截断可能隐藏过冲，不能据此宣称没有振铃。
hint.en: Inspect raw cells near the discontinuity; display clipping can hide overshoot, not eliminate ringing.

t.zh: 你有空间卷积器和频域处理器，现在让同一个规则走两条路径。先将边界设为周期，避免把不同问题当作算法误差；计算工具处理复数乘法，你核对信息路径。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>
t.en: You have spatial and frequency processors. Run one rule through both, using periodic boundaries so the comparison is fair. Arithmetic parts handle complex multiplication while you check the information path. <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 卷积定理的有限实现要匹配核原点、边界、输出域与归一化；等价不保证实现更快。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Finite convolution-theorem implementations must match kernel origin, borders, domains and normalisation. Equivalence does not guarantee speed. <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 空间路径使用周期卷积。频域路径把图像频谱与同一卷积器的单位脉冲响应频谱相乘，再重建；本归一化下系数乘积需要乘 N。输出两条路径及误差。
brief.en: The spatial path uses periodic convolution. Multiply the signal spectrum by the spectrum of the convolver’s impulse response, then reconstruct. With this normalisation multiply the coefficient product by N. Output both paths and their error.

naiveWhy.zh: 周期频域计算不能直接声称等于零补边空间卷积。必须统一边界、核原点和归一化。
naiveWhy.en: Periodic frequency processing is not directly equivalent to zero-padded spatial convolution. Match boundaries, kernel origin and normalisation.

hint.zh: 脉冲先经过自己的周期卷积器，自动建立核在周期数组中的原点。复数乘积的四项算术已放入起始板。
hint.en: Sending an impulse through your periodic convolver establishes the kernel origin. Four complex-product arithmetic terms are already placed in the starter.

t.zh: 二维频谱仪必须能回到图像，才适合做可检查的处理。逆向的数学恒等式已经给出；复用已有机器并保持完整的实虚数据，观察重建与残差。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A 2D analyser must return to images for inspectable processing. The inverse identity is supplied; reuse the machine while retaining both components and inspect reconstruction plus residual. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 实信号及对称增益应留下接近零的虚部残差，可用它检查丢分量或破坏共轭对称。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Real signals with symmetric gains should leave near-zero imaginary residual, useful for detecting lost components or broken conjugate symmetry. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 复用二维前向机做逆向：共轭输入，做前向变换，再共轭并乘 W×H。共轭保留实部、反转虚部。输出重建实部及虚部残差。
brief.en: Reuse the 2D forward machine for inversion: conjugate input, transform, then conjugate and multiply by W×H. Conjugation retains real and negates imaginary parts. Output reconstructed real and imaginary residual.

naiveWhy.zh: 二维前向已经除以 W×H。把相同归一化再用一次而不补偿会压低重建幅度。
naiveWhy.en: The forward transform already divides by W×H. Repeating it without compensation reduces reconstruction gain.

hint.zh: 用常量图检查增益，用长方形图检查 W 与 H。共轭与缩放公式是给定的数学支持。
hint.en: Check gain on constants and W/H on rectangles. Conjugation and scaling identities are supplied mathematical support.

desc.zh: 通过共轭与 W×H 缩放复用自己的二维频谱仪，输出实部和虚部残差。
desc.en: Reuse your 2D analyser through conjugation and WH scaling; retain real output and imaginary residual.

t.zh: 扫描台的局部处理器已经有用，却无法专门区分整幅图上的规则条纹。现在把二维分析、频率选择和二维重建接成机器，再与自己的空间处理器做公平对照。测试明确给出干扰位置，不要求猜频率或手算。 <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Local processing helps the scanner but cannot selectively isolate global periodic stripes. Assemble 2D analysis, gain selection and reconstruction, then compare fairly with your spatial processor. Interference locations are supplied; there is no frequency guessing or hand calculation. <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 二维选择能分开两条轴的频率；逐行对照揭示另一条轴的局限。已知干扰与有用信号重叠时，会损失信息。 <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>
after.en: 2D selection distinguishes both frequency axes; row filtering exposes the other-axis limitation. Useful signal overlapping selected interference is still lost. <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 按已知干扰的成对增益，做二维频域处理与重建。另输出逐行频率处理、局部周期平滑两个对照，检查各自保留和遗漏的信息。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
brief.en: Apply paired gains for known interference using 2D analysis and reconstruction. Also output row-frequency filtering and periodic local smoothing to compare retained and missed information. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 局部平滑会同时削弱有用细节。这里已知干扰集中在指定频率，对应频域处理可以保留其他分量；不声称可自动识别任意干扰。
naiveWhy.en: Local smoothing also suppresses useful detail. Known interference at selected frequencies can be removed while retaining other components; this does not automatically identify arbitrary interference.

hint.zh: 频谱的两分量使用同一增益。先检查重建闭环和虚部残差，再比较局部平滑保留了什么。
hint.en: Apply the same gain to both components. Check reconstruction and imaginary residual before comparing retained details against local smoothing.

hint.zh: 横向频率处理能去掉沿 x 变化的条纹；沿 y 变化的干扰在每行都可能表现为 DC，不能在保留行均值的同时只删掉那部分。
hint.en: Row filtering can remove variation along x. Variation along y may appear as DC in each row; preserving row means cannot selectively remove that part.

t.zh: 波形发生器提供了可比较的刻度，现在让它与观测发生联系。直接看一行平均亮度会漏掉正负抵消的条纹；用匹配波形检验某个频率是否有贡献。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The wave generator provides a basis. Connect it to observations: averaging brightness misses zero-mean stripes. Test a frequency through comparison with its matching wave. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 一个投影取决于频率和相位。单路响应为零，不足以断言该频率不存在。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A projection depends on both frequency and phase. Zero response from one probe does not prove the frequency is absent. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 让图像读数与指定频率、相位的波形逐格比较，输出每行的平均乘积。不同频率会在整行中互相抵消。
brief.en: Compare readings with a specified basis frequency/phase through their mean product per row. Different frequencies cancel over the row.

t.zh: 波形使用每行的归一化位置 x/N；行内位置元件直接给出这张刻度表。投影采用平均乘积而不是总和，使同一周期的读数数量改变时，系数不随行长成倍放大。逐行汇总在这里新增“平均”。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The wave uses normalised positions x/N, supplied by the row-position component. Projection uses mean products rather than sums so changing the number of samples does not multiply coefficient scale. Row reduction now introduces mean. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 只平均基波没有使用观测；相同探针将对所有图像给出同一结果。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging the basis alone ignores the observation, producing the same result for different signals.

hint.zh: 观察同频与异频信号的逐格乘积。平均自动完成，但必须把观测纳入比较。
hint.en: Inspect products for matching and differing frequencies. Mean is automatic, but the observation must participate.

desc.zh: 输出各行观测与指定波形的平均乘积，保留正负。
desc.en: Return each row’s signed mean product with the specified basis wave.

title.en: Do not lose stripes to phase

t.zh: 单频探针在某些平移下没有响应，尽管条纹还在。补上与第一路相差四分之一周的测量，把两路作为同一个系数的两个分量。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A shifted stripe can make one probe silent while remaining visible. Add a quarter-turn projection and retain both components of the same coefficient. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 系数长度便于比较强弱，重建仍需要实部和虚部。普通实信号频率由共轭对共同描述。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Coefficient length compares contributions; reconstruction still needs real and imaginary parts. Conjugate pairs represent real-signal frequencies. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用相差 1/4 周的两路投影测量一个频率。实部使用 cos，虚部使用 −sin，即 cos(角度+1/4周)；再给出系数长度。
brief.en: Measure a frequency using projections a quarter turn apart: real uses cos, imaginary uses −sin = cos(angle+1/4 turn). Also output coefficient length.

naiveWhy.zh: 两次相同相位仍只测一个方向，移动后的条纹可能被漏掉。第二路应当是独立的正交投影。
naiveWhy.en: Repeating one phase still measures one direction and can miss shifted stripes. The other projection must be orthogonal.

hint.zh: 比较同一条纹平移前后：一条投影可变成零，另一路应保留信息。长度由工具计算。
hint.en: Compare shifted versions of a stripe: one projection can vanish while the other retains information. Length is computed.

desc.zh: 保留指定频率的归一化实部、虚部及系数长度。
desc.en: Retain normalised real, imaginary and magnitude components at a specified frequency.

title.en: Grow the probe into a spectrum

t.zh: 单频探针已经可靠。现在由工具展开重复工作，让同一个部件扫描所有离散频率；你负责把读数、频率和输出形状对应起来。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The single-frequency probe works. Expand repeated execution to every discrete frequency using the same part, while keeping observations, frequencies and output shape correctly associated. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 这里 DC 在索引 0，k 与 N−k 配对。未移中心的索引不能全部按“越大频率越高”理解。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
after.en: DC is at index 0 and k pairs with N−k. Larger unshifted indices do not always mean higher frequencies. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 对每行的每个离散频率运行已有探针，按原行次序、再按 k 从 0 开始的次序输出一列幅度，暂不恢复为频谱图。
brief.en: Run the earned probe at every frequency of each row. Output one magnitude column ordered by source row, then k from zero; do not yet restore a spectrum image.

naiveWhy.zh: 检查每行恒定的频率索引与行内变化的位置表。原行读数保持不变，改变的是探测频率。
naiveWhy.en: Distinguish the row-constant frequency index from positions varying within a row. Source readings repeat unchanged; probe frequency varies.

t.zh: 单频探针已经能测给定的 k。展开遍历把原行重复 N 次，并让 k 在重复行间变化；每行内的位置仍随列变化。两种刻度含义不同，先让探针逐频率工作。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The probe measures a supplied k. Expansion repeats each source row N times and changes k between repetitions; sample position still varies within each row. These indices have different meanings. First run the probe across frequencies. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 检查每行恒定的频率索引与行内变化的位置表。原行读数保持不变，改变的是探测频率。
hint.en: Distinguish the row-constant frequency index from positions varying within a row. Source readings repeat unchanged; probe frequency varies.

brief.zh: 让自己的探针对每行的 k=0…N−1 全部工作，保留实部、虚部、幅度。展开遍历替你重复读数和生成索引，不替你算系数。
brief.en: Run your probe at k=0…N−1 for every row, retaining real, imaginary and magnitude outputs. Expansion supplies repetitions and indices, not coefficients.

t.zh: 逐频率探测已经通过。现在把每行的三路系数分别还原为原图宽高，保持同一行、同一频率的实部、虚部和幅度对应。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The frequency scan works. Restore each of its three coefficient channels to the original dimensions, retaining correspondence between real, imaginary and magnitude values at each row/frequency. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 频率索引在不同重复行变化，取样位置在同一行内变化；混用它们就不再是逐频率测量。
naiveWhy.en: Frequency index varies between repeated rows; sample position varies within a row. They have different roles.

hint.zh: 先检查展开表中哪一路每行恒定、哪一路随列变化。k=0 的系数应当等于原行平均值。
hint.en: Inspect which table varies by row and which by column. The k=0 coefficient equals the original row mean.

desc.zh: 用你的正交探针遍历全部频率，输出每行归一化频谱。
desc.en: Scan all frequencies with your quadrature probe to produce normalised row spectra.

t.zh: 频谱仪保留了两路系数，还需要一台合成器才能检查它们是否完整。正向测量与逆向重建共用你造出的波形，但它们的求和方向和归一化职责不同。 <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The analyser retains both components. Build a synthesiser to check whether information is complete. Analysis and reconstruction reuse the wave generator but differ in summation roles and normalisation. <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 完整系数可以还原数值。常量、相位和不同长度的测试分别检查增益、符号与归一化。 <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Complete coefficients recover values. Constants, phases and varying lengths test gain, signs and normalisation. <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 前向系数已经除以 N。按所有频率合成每个位置：实部乘 cos，虚部乘 sin 后相减；此处波形器可用 +1/4 周产生 −sin，因此相应调整组合符号。不要再平均。
brief.en: Forward coefficients already include 1/N. Synthesis sums real·cos − imaginary·sin across frequencies. The wave generator supplies −sin via +1/4 turn; account for that sign. Do not average again.

naiveWhy.zh: 再次平均会多除一次 N，使重建幅度变小。前向与逆向的归一化必须配套。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging again divides by N twice and reduces reconstruction amplitude. Forward and inverse normalisation must match.

hint.zh: 先用只有 DC 的常量图检查总增益，再用有相位的条纹检查虚部符号。所有乘积与累加自动计算。
hint.en: Check gain using DC-only constants, then imaginary signs using phased stripes. Arithmetic and accumulation are automatic.

desc.zh: 按归一化实部、虚部系数合成图像，复用你的波形电路。
desc.en: Reconstruct from normalised real and imaginary coefficients using your wave circuit.

title.zh: 幅度相同，位置可以不同

t.zh: 重建器可以检验“频率有多少”是否足够。现在交换两张图的幅度来源和相位来源，检查空间结构跟随哪一部分。只在非零系数上讨论相位，零系数的方向没有意义。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Use the synthesiser to test whether frequency amounts alone suffice. Mix magnitude and phase sources and inspect spatial structure. Phase is meaningful for nonzero coefficients; zero coefficients have no direction. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 相位保留频率的空间排列。丢掉相位可能改变结构，不仅是降低清晰度。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Phase retains spatial arrangement. Losing it can change structure, not merely sharpness. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 把每对频率系数缩放到给定长度，保持实部与虚部的比例和符号。两分量同为 0 时仍输出 0；用给定下限保护除数。
brief.en: Rescale each coefficient pair to the supplied length while retaining its component ratio and signs. A zero pair stays zero; use the supplied floor to protect division.

naiveWhy.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
naiveWhy.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

t.zh: 频率系数的两分量共同确定长度与方向。同一个正比例同时作用于实部和虚部，会改变长度而保留方向；零系数没有可保留的方向。先在系数表上验证，再交换图像的幅度和相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A coefficient pair determines length and direction together. One positive scale changes length while retaining direction; a zero pair has no direction to preserve. Verify coefficient rescaling before exchanging image magnitudes and phases. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 长度由向量长度元件计算。比例取决于目标长度与当前长度；把两个分量一起改变，观察负号是否保留。
hint.en: The length component supplies current magnitude. Scaling depends on desired versus current length; change both components together and inspect retained signs.

brief.zh: 重建时保留 B 的相位关系，使用 A 的频谱幅度。把 B 的两分量一起缩放到 A 的系数长度；零长度使用给定安全下限 10⁻¹²。 B 中的零系数保留为零。
brief.en: Reconstruct using B’s phase relationships and A’s magnitudes. Scale both B components together to A’s coefficient lengths; use the supplied 10⁻¹² floor for zero lengths. Zero coefficients in B remain zero.

t.zh: 系数缩放已能保留方向。现在把它接在两台频谱仪之后：从一张图取得目标幅度，从另一张图保留相位关系，再交给已验证的重建器。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
t.en: Coefficient rescaling now retains direction. Apply it after two spectrum analysers: take desired magnitudes from one image, preserve phase relationships from the other, and use the earned synthesiser. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 把幅度当作全部实部并把虚部设零，会人为指定所有相位，而不是保留 B 的空间关系。
naiveWhy.en: Using magnitudes as real components and zero imaginary components imposes phases instead of retaining B’s spatial relationships.

hint.zh: 同一比例缩放实部和虚部会改变长度而保持方向。先比较平移前后的同一形状。
hint.en: Scaling both components equally changes length but preserves direction. Start by comparing a shape with its translation.

title.zh: 让频谱仪接收自己的输出
title.en: Let the analyser receive complex data

t.zh: 二维处理要把第一条轴的结果送往第二条轴，它已不再只有实数读数。先扩展现有频谱仪的输入契约，避免第二次处理时丢掉一半信息。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A second image axis receives complex results from the first. Extend the analyser’s input contract before that pass so it does not drop half the information. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 复用实数频谱仪处理两分量，再按复数关系组合；第二条轴不能静默丢弃虚部。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Reuse the real-valued analyser for both components and combine them correctly. The second axis must retain imaginary information. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 中间数据可能已有实部和虚部。分别用自己的频谱仪处理两张实数表，再按 i²=−1 合并，保留完整复数输出。
brief.en: Intermediate data may already have real and imaginary parts. Analyse each real-valued table with your analyser, then combine using i²=−1, retaining a complex output.

naiveWhy.zh: 第二条输入也是信号。二维的第二轴不能丢弃第一轴产生的虚部。
naiveWhy.en: The imaginary input also carries signal. A second-axis transform must retain first-axis imaginary data.

hint.zh: 将 (a+ib)(c+id) 的四项贡献分为实部和虚部，i²=−1；算术由元件执行。
hint.en: Group the four contributions of (a+ib)(c+id), using i²=−1. Parts do the arithmetic.

desc.zh: 复用两次自己的逐行频谱仪，接收并输出实部、虚部。
desc.en: Reuse your row analyser on real/imaginary inputs and retain both outputs.

title.zh: 从一行到两个空间方向
title.en: From rows to two spatial axes

t.zh: 复数频谱仪可以处理上一轮的输出，现在把同一台机器沿两条轴复用。用横纹、竖纹与长方形输入检查频率轴是否对应正确。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The complex analyser can process its own output. Reuse it along both axes and check frequency axes with horizontal stripes, vertical stripes and rectangular inputs. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 二维频谱描述两轴变化，条纹方向与变化方向不同。索引仍按未移中心的周期顺序保存。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
after.en: The 2D spectrum describes variation along both axes. Stripe and variation directions differ; indices remain in unshifted periodic order. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 只分析列方向的频率：让逐行复数频谱仪处理原图的每列，再把输出恢复为原来的宽高。保留两分量及幅度，横向此时仍代表原来的列。
brief.en: Analyse column frequencies only: use the row complex analyser on each original column, then restore the original dimensions. Retain both components and magnitude; columns still identify original spatial columns.

naiveWhy.zh: 横向仍应保留原图各列的对应。只在机器入口交换，会让结果接口的宽高仍是交换后的形状。
naiveWhy.en: The output must retain correspondence with original spatial columns. Swapping only at the input leaves dimensions reversed at the interface.

t.zh: 逐行机器不能直接把一列当作一行。行列互换会交换宽高并把 (x,y) 放到 (y,x)，数值不变；复数两分量必须一起交换。用非方形图追踪进入机器和返回接口时的形状。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A row machine cannot directly consume columns. Transpose swaps dimensions and moves (x,y) to (y,x) without changing values; both complex components must move together. Track rectangular shapes into the machine and back to the interface. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

hint.zh: 横向仍应保留原图各列的对应。只在机器入口交换，会让结果接口的宽高仍是交换后的形状。
hint.en: The output must retain correspondence with original spatial columns. Swapping only at the input leaves dimensions reversed at the interface.

brief.zh: 先处理每行，再沿另一条轴处理完整复数结果，最后恢复原来的轴顺序。输入可能是长方形，输出也必须保持相同宽高。
brief.en: Transform rows, then the other axis using complete complex results, and restore the original axis order. Rectangular inputs must retain their width and height.

t.zh: 列方向处理已经能往返保持形状。现在让同一台机器沿两方向连续工作，使横向和纵向都成为频率刻度，而不是只把逐行结果换一个摆放方向。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The column transform now preserves interface shape. Compose both directions so horizontal and vertical coordinates both become frequency indices, rather than merely rearranging a row spectrum. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

naiveWhy.zh: 第二次处理时轴顺序已经交换，输出接口还需要交换回来。方形图片可能掩盖尺寸问题。
naiveWhy.en: Axis order changes for the second pass and must be restored. Square images can hide the shape mistake.

hint.zh: 用长方形测试追踪每一步的宽高，同时保留两条复数分量。
hint.en: Track dimensions through the rectangular case and retain both complex components.

desc.zh: 沿两轴复用自己的复数逐行变换，输出归一化的实部、虚部与幅度。
desc.en: Reuse your complex row transform along both axes and retain normalised real, imaginary and magnitude outputs.

t.zh: 重建器让你能够改系数再回到图像。先从频率到零点的距离造增益，再把它接入完整的频率处理路径；不要把相位作为无关数据丢弃。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The synthesiser lets you modify coefficients and return to images. Construct gains from frequency distance, then connect the full filtering path while retaining phase information. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 增益决定保留的尺度。实信号要成对处理正负频率，并对两分量使用一致增益。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Gains select scales. Treat conjugate frequencies in pairs and apply consistent gains to both components. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 频率表按未移中心顺序给出带符号的周期数。保留 |k|<cutoff，边界频率不保留。输出成对的低通增益，无需手算索引。
brief.en: Signed frequency indices are supplied in unshifted order. Keep |k|<cutoff, excluding the boundary, to produce paired low-pass gains without index calculations.

naiveWhy.zh: 只比较有符号大小会让所有负频率通过。实信号的正负频率必须按相同规则处理。
naiveWhy.en: Comparing signed values alone keeps all negative frequencies. Real-signal frequency pairs need matching rules.

hint.zh: 频率有正负，低通关心离零频率的距离。
hint.en: Frequency has a sign; low-pass depends on distance from zero.

brief.zh: 用给定增益同时调整每个系数的两分量，再重建。增益满足共轭配对；既要支持低通，也要支持去 DC 或带通。
brief.en: Apply supplied gains to both coefficient components before reconstruction. Gains preserve conjugate pairing; support low-pass, DC removal and band selection.

naiveWhy.zh: 只改实部会让同一频率的相位和幅度关系失衡，带相位的条纹尤其明显。
naiveWhy.en: Changing only the real component distorts the coefficient; phased stripes expose it.

hint.zh: 如果要删除一个频率，它的两路投影都不能留下。
hint.en: Removing a frequency requires removing both projection components.

desc.zh: 用自己的频谱仪、双分量增益与重建器处理每行。
desc.en: Filter rows using your analyser, paired component gains and synthesiser.

body.zh: 图像差分在对应位置和通道比较读数。带符号的差保留变化方向，绝对差保留变化大小。数值和位置是不同信息，图像算术逐位置执行。
body.en: Image differencing compares corresponding locations and channels. Signed difference retains direction; absolute difference retains size. Values and positions are distinct; image arithmetic acts at matching locations.

body.zh: 常见误解：只留下正变化，或把负数显示成黑色就认为没有变化。
body.en: Common misconception: Keeping only positive changes, or treating clipped negative display values as no change.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support

body.zh: 逐位置比较需要同一场景位置对应。这里约定输出 (x,y) 读取输入 (x+dx,y+dy)，x 向右、y 向下为正；有限图像之外的值来自边界假设。
body.en: Pointwise comparison requires corresponding scene locations. Here output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy), with x right and y down. Outside values follow an explicit boundary assumption.

body.zh: 常见误解：给像素值加 dx 就是在移动图像。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: Common misconception: Adding dx to pixel values moves the image. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption

body.zh: 测量输出保留变化量，判定根据任务给定的准则将证据转为标记。阈值比较不是对物体语义或缺陷成因的推断。
body.en: Measurements retain change values; a task criterion turns evidence into a decision mask. Thresholding does not infer object meaning or defect cause.

body.zh: 常见误解：测量值本身就是缺陷类别，或者零与非零足以处理所有读数波动。
body.en: Common misconception: Treating measurements as defect classes, or assuming every nonzero change must fail.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md image arrays; L3 point operations; inspection/tolerance is a controlled application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md image arrays; L3 point operations; inspection/tolerance is a controlled application

body.zh: 线性局部运算把邻域的对应读数与权重相乘后相加。位置和符号有意义；对恒定输入，权重和决定输出增益。
body.en: A linear local operation sums position-matched weighted readings. Positions and signs matter; the weight sum determines constant-input gain.

body.zh: 常见误解：交换左右权重不会改变结果，或者所有权重都必须为正并且总和为 1。
body.en: Common misconception: Swapping side weights has no effect, or all filters must have positive unit-sum weights.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp8–18,21–23
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp8–18,21–23

body.zh: 若二维核是两个一维权重向量的外积，可以先后沿两轴计算，减少每个像素的加权次数。非可分离核不能直接这样替代；有限图像要保持相同边界与输出域。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: An outer-product kernel can be applied as consecutive 1D passes, reducing weighted samples per pixel. Nonseparable kernels cannot be replaced this way, and boundaries/domains must agree. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 常见误解：两条轴各处理一次再相加就等于二维平均。
body.en: Common misconception: Adding independent axis outputs is a 2D average.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp37–40
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp37–40

body.zh: 互相关将书写核按中心对齐邻域，保持核的书写方向，计算对应元素乘积之和。核尺寸决定支持域，权重决定响应。
body.en: Correlation centres a written kernel without reversing it and sums matching products. Kernel size determines support; weights determine response.

body.zh: 常见误解：权重乘完之后还要再平均一次，或表中每行是一整张新图。
body.en: Common misconception: Averaging after weighting, or treating each table row as a separate full image.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp9–18,31–35
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp9–18,31–35

body.zh: 数学离散卷积使用反转的核，相比互相关需将核旋转 180 度。非对称核揭示方向差别；对称核会隐藏它。
body.en: Discrete mathematical convolution reverses the kernel: rotate it 180 degrees relative to correlation. Asymmetric kernels reveal the difference; symmetric ones hide it.

body.zh: 常见误解：对称模糊结果一致，就认为卷积和互相关没有区别。
body.en: Common misconception: Assuming convolution and correlation are identical because symmetric blurs agree.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp17–18
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp17–18

body.zh: 离散高斯样本可归一化为平滑核，尺度和支持域影响响应。非锐化增强把带符号的高频细节加回原图；不能保证恢复真实场景。
body.en: Normalised sampled Gaussian weights form a smoother whose scale and support affect response. Unsharp enhancement adds signed high-frequency detail back to the original; it does not guarantee scene recovery.

body.zh: 常见误解：平滑只删除噪声，或增强可以用绝对差代替带符号差。
body.en: Common misconception: Smoothing removes only noise, or absolute difference can replace signed detail for enhancement.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp24–28,35
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp24–28,35

body.zh: 有限图像没有图外观测，补边只是对图外的一种猜测，各适合不同的材料：补 0 最简单，但可能造出黑边；复制最近边缘对普通照片通常较自然；周期延续把左右、上下相接，适合可以无缝平铺的纹理，不适合普通照片；镜像延续让边缘两侧对称，常能减少人工边界。没有一种规则永远最好。valid 只保留完整邻域，因此输出尺寸依核支持缩小。
body.en: Finite images have no outside observations, so padding is a guess about the outside, each suiting different material: zero is simplest but can create dark borders; replicating the nearest edge is usually natural for ordinary photographs; periodic continuation joins left to right and top to bottom, suiting seamlessly tileable textures but not ordinary photographs; reflection mirrors the edge and often reduces artificial borders. No rule is always best. Valid output keeps full neighbourhoods and shrinks with support.

body.zh: 常见误解：所有补边只影响外观，或保持原宽高的补边等于 valid。
body.en: Common misconception: Padding only affects appearance, or same-size padding is equivalent to valid output.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp41–45

body.zh: 图像梯度由两条空间轴的偏导数组成，离散差分近似它们。分量的正负保留变化方向，核约定与坐标方向必须明确。
body.en: An image gradient contains derivatives along both spatial axes, approximated by differences. Signs retain direction; kernel and coordinate conventions must be explicit.

body.zh: 常见误解：把同一张变化图当作两个方向，或者忽略负响应。
body.en: Common misconception: Using one response for both axes, or discarding negative responses.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

body.zh: Sobel 沿一轴差分、沿垂直轴平滑，组成二维方向核。梯度长度为 sqrt(gx²+gy²)，区别于有符号相加。尺度、噪声和边界都会影响响应。
body.en: Sobel combines a derivative along one axis with smoothing along the other. Gradient length is sqrt(gx²+gy²), not signed addition. Scale, noise and boundaries affect responses.

body.zh: 常见误解：应沿求导轴再次平均，或用 gx+gy 代替长度。
body.en: Common misconception: Smoothing along the derivative axis, or replacing length with gx+gy.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

body.zh: 多通道图像在每个位置有多个读数。跨通道加权和将它们组合为新的测量，空间索引保持不变；多个输出核可以形成多个输出通道。
body.en: A multi-channel image contains several readings per position. A weighted channel sum combines them into a measurement without changing positions; multiple output kernels can form multiple channels.

body.zh: 常见误解：只取某一通道总能代替颜色组合，或通道混合会移动像素。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: Common misconception: One channel always suffices, or mixing channels moves pixels. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp31–32
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp31–32

body.zh: 视觉流水线将已有测量、预处理和判定模块组合。每个模块有输入输出含义；顺序和边界影响结果，最终响应仍受任务假设限制。
body.en: A visual pipeline composes measurements, preprocessing and decisions with explicit input/output meaning. Order and boundaries matter, and task assumptions limit the final response.

body.zh: 常见误解：把原图直接接入边缘检测，再靠阈值弥补所有干扰。
body.en: Common misconception: Feeding raw input to edge measurement and relying on thresholding to remove all nuisance.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md common filters and composition; controlled scanner application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md common filters and composition; controlled scanner application

body.zh: 余弦波可写成 A cos(2π(kx/N+p))。k 控制整行周期数，A 控制幅度，p 控制相位；这里相位以周为单位。波形的负值仍是有效计算数据。
body.en: A cosine wave is A cos(2π(kx/N+p)): k controls cycles per row, A amplitude and p phase. This interface measures phase in turns. Negative wave values remain valid data.

body.zh: 常见误解：频率是统一加到每个位置的偏移。
body.en: Common misconception: Frequency is an offset added to every position.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp7–21; turns are the declared mathematical unit
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp7–21; turns are the declared mathematical unit

body.zh: 将信号与基函数相乘并累加，可测量该方向的投影系数。这里按行长归一化为平均值；异频项在完整离散周期上正交抵消。单一相位只能测到一个方向。
body.en: Multiplication and accumulation measure a signal’s projection onto a basis. Here the coefficient is normalised by row length. Different discrete frequencies are orthogonal across complete cycles; a single phase measures only one direction.

body.zh: 常见误解：探针自己有波形就能测量，或一次零响应等于频率不存在。
body.en: Common misconception: The basis alone measures the signal, or one zero response proves absence.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform PDF pp18–24
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform PDF pp18–24

body.zh: 离散傅里叶系数的实部投影到 cos，虚部投影到 −sin。幅度是两分量的长度，相位由两分量的关系确定；这里只用归一化系数，不把系数幅度直接叫作波的峰值幅度。
body.en: The DFT real part projects onto cos and the imaginary part onto −sin. Their length is coefficient magnitude and their relationship determines phase. Normalised coefficient magnitude is not automatically the sinusoid’s peak amplitude.

body.zh: 常见误解：重复同一投影可以补齐相位，或系数幅度足够重建原图。
body.en: Common misconception: Duplicating one projection recovers phase, or magnitude alone reconstructs the image.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–24,33–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–24,33–34

body.zh: 离散频谱保留全部基函数投影。这里前向按 N 归一化，DC 位于索引 0；实信号的 k 与 N−k 系数互为共轭，索引应按周期解释。
body.en: The discrete spectrum retains all basis projections. This convention normalises forward coefficients by N and stores DC at index 0. For real signals, k and N−k are conjugate and indices are periodic.

body.zh: 常见误解：把取样位置当作频率索引，或只保留一半而不说明如何恢复。
body.en: Common misconception: Confusing sample positions with frequency indices, or discarding half the data without a recovery rule.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–26
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp18–26

body.zh: 逆变换把各频率按复数系数组合。这里前向除以 N、逆向直接求和；实输出为 Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin)。只保留幅度通常不能还原原有空间关系。
body.en: Inverse transformation combines frequencies using complex coefficients. This convention divides forward by N and sums inverse terms: Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin) for real output. Magnitude alone usually loses spatial relationships.

body.zh: 常见误解：逆向也要平均，或者把虚部符号照搬为同相余弦。
body.en: Common misconception: Averaging in both directions, or using the wrong imaginary contribution.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform and magnitude/phase PDF pp18–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform and magnitude/phase PDF pp18–34

body.zh: 平移可在保留频谱幅度时改变相位。幅度和相位共同决定重建，交换相位会改变结构；频谱为零的位置没有可定义的相位方向。
body.en: Translation can change phase while retaining magnitudes. Both determine reconstruction; phase exchange changes structure. Zero coefficients have no defined phase direction.

body.zh: 常见误解：幅度就是可重建的完整频谱，虚部是无用噪声。
body.en: Common misconception: Magnitude is the complete reconstructible spectrum and imaginary components are noise.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp33–34
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp33–34

body.zh: 傅里叶变换是线性的。对 a+ib，可分别计算 F(a)、F(b)，再组成 F(a)+iF(b)；乘 i 会交换实虚贡献并改变其中一项符号。
body.en: The Fourier transform is linear: F(a+ib)=F(a)+iF(b). Multiplying by i exchanges real/imaginary contributions and negates one component.

body.zh: 常见误解：第二条轴只需处理第一条轴的实部。
body.en: Common misconception: The second axis needs only the first pass’s real part.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier representation and linearity; complex arithmetic is supplied support
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier representation and linearity; complex arithmetic is supplied support

body.zh: 二维 DFT 可分解为两条轴的完整复数一维变换。每条频率轴描述相应空间方向的变化；本约定总前向归一化为 1/(WH)。
body.en: The 2D DFT separates into complete complex 1D transforms along both axes. Frequency axes correspond to spatial variation; this convention normalises forward by 1/(WH).

body.zh: 常见误解：第二次仍沿原来的行处理，或不恢复原图轴顺序。
body.en: Common misconception: Transforming original rows twice, or failing to restore axis order.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32

body.zh: 频域滤波以逐频率增益乘复数系数再逆变换。低通保留接近零的频率，高通去掉低频，带通保留一个范围；实输出要求增益与共轭对称一致。
body.en: Frequency filtering multiplies complex coefficients by gains before inversion. Low-pass keeps frequencies near zero, high-pass removes low frequencies, and band-pass keeps a range. Real output requires conjugate-consistent gains.

body.zh: 常见误解：只调整实部，或者负索引天然属于低频。
body.en: Common misconception: Adjusting only real components, or treating every negative index as low frequency.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp38–43
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp38–43

body.zh: 硬频率截止对应振荡的空间核，可能在突变附近产生振铃。渐变过渡改变空间响应，以额外平滑换取不同的振荡表现；应检查未截断数值。
body.en: Hard frequency cutoffs correspond to oscillatory spatial kernels and can ring near discontinuities. Tapering changes that response, trading additional smoothing for different oscillation behaviour. Inspect unclipped values.

body.zh: 常见误解：频域低通总是没有副作用，显示中没看到过冲就不存在。
body.en: Common misconception: Low-pass has no side effects, or invisible clipped overshoot does not exist.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp44–47
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp44–47

body.zh: 空间卷积对应频域复数逐点乘积。离散有限实现需匹配周期/补边约定、核原点、输出域和归一化；本例对每行使用周期卷积。
body.en: Spatial convolution corresponds to pointwise complex frequency multiplication. Finite implementations must match periodic/padding conventions, kernel origin, output domain and normalisation. This task uses circular row convolution.

body.zh: 常见误解：把周期频域结果与零边界卷积比较，认为差异就是算法错误。
body.en: Common misconception: Comparing periodic frequency processing with zero-boundary convolution as if they were the same problem.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp35–37
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp35–37

body.zh: 本约定的二维前向除以 WH。逆变换可用共轭输入、前向变换、共轭结果再乘 WH 实现。实输出的虚部残差可检查频率操作的一致性。
body.en: This 2D forward convention divides by WH. Inversion can conjugate input, transform, conjugate output and multiply by WH. Imaginary residuals help check frequency-operation consistency.

body.zh: 常见误解：前向归一化重复使用不影响幅度，或可以静默丢弃非零虚部。
body.en: Common misconception: Repeated forward normalisation preserves amplitude, or a nonzero imaginary result may be silently discarded.

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform/inverse, complex magnitude/phase; conjugation identity is mathematical support
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform/inverse, complex magnitude/phase; conjugation identity is mathematical support

body.zh: 周期干扰常集中于特定频率。选择性增益可以抑制它，但与这些频率重叠的有用信号也会被抑制；噪声识别、边界与频率模型是任务假设。
body.en: Periodic interference can concentrate at selected frequencies. Selective gains suppress it but also remove useful signal at those frequencies. Interference identity, boundaries and frequency models are assumptions.

body.zh: 常见误解：任何平滑都只删噪声，或指定频率的抑制等于自动理解哪些像素是噪声。 <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
body.en: Common misconception: Every smoother removes only noise, or suppressing specified frequencies automatically identifies nuisance pixels. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

body.zh: 出处：docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32,38–47; controlled known-frequency application
body.en: Source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp25–32,38–47; controlled known-frequency application

body.zh: 坐标从 0 开始，x 向右、y 向下。数值表中每格保存读数或位置；点击可查看其原值。
body.en: Coordinates start at zero, x right and y down. A cell stores a reading or a position; select it to inspect the original value.

body.zh: 图像采样格，包含一个或多个通道读数。显示亮度限于 0–1，计算值可超出该区间。
body.en: An image sample location with one or more channel readings. Display is clipped to 0–1, but stored values may lie outside it.

desc.zh: 逐值去掉正负号，保留大小。图像数值不截断。
desc.en: Remove the sign of each value, retaining its magnitude without clipping.

desc.zh: 按 a 运算 b，运算在元件上选定。图像按对应格逐值计算；图和数配对时，数用于每格。
desc.en: Compute a op b with the operation chosen on the part, cell by cell for images; a number paired with an image applies to every cell.

about.zh: 加：a + b。
about.en: Add: a + b.

about.zh: 减：a − b。
about.en: Subtract: a − b.

about.zh: 乘：a × b。
about.en: Multiply: a × b.

about.zh: 除：a ÷ b，除数为 0 时报告错误。
about.en: Divide: a ÷ b; division by zero reports an error.

arithmetic.compute: match $op { add: add(a, b), sub: sub(a, b), mul: mul(a, b), div: div(a, b) }

desc.zh: 给出彩色像素里第 c 个位置（0、1、2，在元件上选）上的数组成的灰度图。哪个位置是哪种颜色，看图按什么顺序存：RGB 图的 0 是红，BGR 图的 0 是蓝。
desc.en: Gives the grey image of the numbers at position c (0, 1 or 2, set on the part) of each colour pixel. Which colour sits at a position depends on the image’s channel order: in an RGB image 0 is red, in a BGR one blue.

desc.zh: 从一个口输出固定值。选择当前可用的类型，再填写对应的数值分量。
desc.en: Output one fixed value. Choose an available type and enter its numeric components.

about.zh: 数值：输出一个固定数。
about.en: Scalar: output one fixed number.

about.zh: 二维向量：填写 x、y，输出 (x,y)，可用作取样方向。
about.en: 2D vector: enter x/y to output (x,y), for example as a sampling direction.

about.zh: 三项权重：按前、中、后填写，整组输出 [前,中,后]。
about.en: Three weights: enter first/centre/last and output the whole weight vector.

const.compute: match $kind { scalar: $value, direction: vector2($x, $y), weights: weightVector($first, $centre, $last) }

desc.zh: 输入以周为单位的角度。输出 cos(2πa)：0 周为 1，1/4 周为 0，1/2 周为 −1。数或图逐值计算。
desc.en: Compute cos(2πa) for an angle in turns: 0 gives 1, 1/4 gives 0, 1/2 gives −1. Applies elementwise.

desc.zh: 宽为 N 时，把原图每行重复 N 次。另给出每格的位置 x/N、当前重复的索引 k。每行计算一个结果后，用还原形状恢复原宽高。不生成波形或频谱。
desc.en: Repeat every source row N times, where N is its width. Also expose sample positions x/N and repetition indices k. Compute one result per row and restore shape. No waves or spectra are generated.

desc.zh: a 小于 b 时给出 1，否则给出 0。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives 1 where a is less than b, else 0. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 将 x、y 作为两个互相垂直的分量，计算 sqrt(x² + y²)。数值和同尺寸图都可使用。自动计算，不改变方向分量本身。
desc.en: Treat x and y as perpendicular components and compute sqrt(x² + y²). Works on numbers and matching images. The arithmetic is automatic; the components themselves remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 给出两者中大的那个。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the larger of the two. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 生成与图同尺寸的位置表：每行依次保存 0/N、1/N…(N−1)/N。保存的是位置，不是亮度。
desc.en: Generate a same-size position table containing 0/N, 1/N, …, (N−1)/N in each row. These are positions, not intensities.

desc.zh: 每行独立汇总，得到一列结果。数值计算自动完成，RGB 各通道分别处理。
desc.en: Reduce each row independently into a column. RGB channels are handled separately.

about.zh: 平均：一行的和再除以该行宽度。
about.en: Mean: the row's sum divided by its width.

about.zh: 求和：把一行的读数加起来。
about.en: Sum: add up the row's readings.

desc.zh: 输入是一列逐位置结果，按原来的行序还原为“尺寸参照”的宽高。只排布数据，不做计算。
desc.en: Arrange a column of per-position results into the reference width and height in row order. No arithmetic is performed.

desc.zh: 把表旋转 180 度：行序和每行的次序一起反转。不会对图像做滤波。
desc.en: Rotate a table 180 degrees, reversing both axes. No filtering is performed.

desc.zh: 输出位置 (x,y) 读取输入的 (x+dx,y+dy)。dx 向右、dy 向下为正，须为整数。只改变读取的位置，不改变亮度；图外遵循所选规则。
desc.en: Output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy). Integer dx is positive right, dy down. Values are unchanged; outside reads use the selected rule.

desc.zh: 给出图的宽 w 和高 h。
desc.en: Gives an image’s width w and height h.

desc.zh: 交换图像的行和列。原来的 (x,y) 成为 (y,x)，宽高互换，数值和通道不变。
desc.en: Exchange rows and columns: (x,y) becomes (y,x). Width and height swap; values and channels remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 横向两端各去掉 rx 列，纵向两端各去掉 ry 行。用于显示邻域完全位于原图内的输出。宽高由系统计算。
desc.en: Remove rx columns at each horizontal edge and ry rows at each vertical edge, exposing outputs whose neighbourhood stays inside. Dimensions are computed automatically.

desc.zh: 核的中心依次对齐每个输出位置。每个位置展开为一行：读数表与权重表按核的书写顺序一一对应。保留 RGB 通道；不翻核、不相乘、不求和。
desc.en: Centre the kernel at each output location. Each location becomes a row of samples and matching written-order weights. RGB is retained. No kernel reversal, multiplication or summation is performed.

desc.zh: 权重向量按 [前, 中, 后] 排列，读取 -d、当前位置、+d。d=(1,0) 横向，(0,1) 纵向。权重不自动归一化，保留符号和通道；图外遵循所选规则。
desc.en: Read at -d, the current position and +d with weights [first, centre, last]. d=(1,0) is horizontal and (0,1) vertical. Preserve signs and channels without normalising weights; use the selected border rule.

learner.zh: 掌握中学数学、未学过计算机视觉的玩家
learner.en: Learners with school mathematics and no computer-vision background

endpoint.zh: 从基础图像元件造出比较仪、扫描器和二维频率去干扰仪
endpoint.en: Build a comparator, scanner and 2D frequency interference remover from basic image parts

scope.zh: 实现第 0–2 阶段；L2 图像表示、L3 局部处理、L4 频域及 L5 梯度。计算与重复布局辅助提供，不考工具 API。
scope.en: Stages 0–2: L2 image representation, L3 local processing, L4 frequency methods and L5 gradients. Calculation and repeated layout are supplied; tool APIs are not assessed.

why.zh: 玩家造出的电路成为后续部件
why.en: Passed circuits become reusable parts

about.zh: 自动计算并追踪数、图像和展开表
about.en: Automatically evaluate and trace numbers, images and unfolded tables

lacks.zh: 本阶段仅实现该机器的明确输入输出，后续能力另行构建。
lacks.en: This stage implements the declared machine contract; later capabilities require construction.

lacks.zh: 本阶段仅实现该机器的明确输入输出，后续能力另行构建。
lacks.en: This stage implements the declared machine contract; later capabilities require construction.

lacks.zh: 本阶段仅实现该机器的明确输入输出，后续能力另行构建。
lacks.en: This stage implements the declared machine contract; later capabilities require construction.

about.zh: 图像差分在对应位置和通道比较读数。带符号的差保留变化方向，绝对差保留变化大小。数值和位置是不同信息，图像算术逐位置执行。
about.en: Image differencing compares corresponding locations and channels. Signed difference retains direction; absolute difference retains size. Values and positions are distinct; image arithmetic acts at matching locations.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support

wall.zh: 怎样同时发现比参照更亮和更暗的变化？
wall.en: How can both brighter and darker changes be retained?

misconception.zh: 只留下正变化，或把负数显示成黑色就认为没有变化。
misconception.en: Keeping only positive changes, or treating clipped negative display values as no change.

about.zh: 逐位置比较需要同一场景位置对应。这里约定输出 (x,y) 读取输入 (x+dx,y+dy)，x 向右、y 向下为正；有限图像之外的值来自边界假设。
about.en: Pointwise comparison requires corresponding scene locations. Here output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy), with x right and y down. Outside values follow an explicit boundary assumption.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption

wall.zh: 怎样避免把已知错位当作缺陷？
wall.en: How can a known displacement be excluded from defect evidence?

misconception.zh: 给像素值加 dx 就是在移动图像。
misconception.en: Adding dx to pixel values moves the image.

about.zh: 线性局部运算把邻域的对应读数与权重相乘后相加。位置和符号有意义；对恒定输入，权重和决定输出增益。
about.en: A linear local operation sums position-matched weighted readings. Positions and signs matter; the weight sum determines constant-input gain.

wall.zh: 怎样让多个邻居分别贡献到一个输出？
wall.en: How can several neighbours contribute separately to one output?

misconception.zh: 交换左右权重不会改变结果，或者所有权重都必须为正并且总和为 1。
misconception.en: Swapping side weights has no effect, or all filters must have positive unit-sum weights.

about.zh: 若二维核是两个一维权重向量的外积，可以先后沿两轴计算，减少每个像素的加权次数。非可分离核不能直接这样替代；有限图像要保持相同边界与输出域。
about.en: An outer-product kernel can be applied as consecutive 1D passes, reducing weighted samples per pixel. Nonseparable kernels cannot be replaced this way, and boundaries/domains must agree.

wall.zh: 怎样复用一维处理得到二维邻域，而不遗漏角点？
wall.en: How can a 1D construction cover a 2D neighbourhood including corners?

misconception.zh: 两条轴各处理一次再相加就等于二维平均。
misconception.en: Adding independent axis outputs is a 2D average.

about.zh: 互相关将书写核按中心对齐邻域，保持核的书写方向，计算对应元素乘积之和。核尺寸决定支持域，权重决定响应。
about.en: Correlation centres a written kernel without reversing it and sums matching products. Kernel size determines support; weights determine response.

wall.zh: 怎样用同一个电路处理不同形状的局部规则？
